documents.title: Eurocircuits PCB design guidelines: Edge connectors
documents.used_for: inner-layer clearance 20 deg 3.00 / 30 deg 2.00 / 45-60 deg 1.00 mm; PTH, SMD and copper >= 2.00 mm from the finger inner edge; min remaining thickness 0.25 mm; standard bevel needs >= 40 mm perpendicular dimension

documents.title: Eurocircuits: What is edge connector bevelling?
PCBWay: PCB gold fingers
documents.used_for: chamfer table (1.6 mm: 45 deg h 0.5 / 30 deg h 0.95 / 20 deg h 1.51 mm, remaining 0.5 mm), angle +/-5 deg, height +/-5 mil; no SMD/PTH/pads within 1 mm; inner copper removal > 3 mm; continuous mask opening; immersion gold 1-3 uin vs electroplated 3-50 uin

documents.title: JLCPCB blog: All you need to know about PCB gold fingers
documents.used_for: no plated holes/SMD/pads within 1.0 mm of fingers; no mask or silk near fingers; hard gold 1-2 um over 3-6 um Ni (generic). JLC's own help article with the bevel/setback table is saved by another engineer in ../jlc/

documents.title: Advanced Circuits: Hard gold, hard work - designing PCB edge connectors that last
documents.used_for: hard gold 0.5-1.0 um over 3-7 um Ni; ENIG 'will degrade quickly if used in edge connector' applications; bevel 20-45 deg

documents.title: Lion Circuits: PCB gold finger
documents.used_for: generic keep-out repeats (1 mm), bevel 30-45 deg

documents.title: Antmicro lpddr4-testbed (LPDDR4 test module in DDR4 SO-DIMM form factor), KiCad sources
documents.used_for: practical comparison: fingers 0.35 x 2.50 mm with 0.05 mm setback, tooling holes 1.8 mm at (2.0, 6.0), 61 vias within 1 mm of finger tops, AT24CS01 ID EEPROM (IC2) on the SO-DIMM I2C pins, KiCad stackup 1.6 mm (no fab notes in repo)
